lines.t: I see the sorrow in Your eyes
I hear it in the night
You keep on calling children home
But they keep running from the light
You love them still, You love them long
You love them still, You love them long
Even when they turn away
And every tear You carry, Lord
Feels like more than I can say
Where Your tears fall, let me stand
Where Your heart is breaking, let me understand
While I can still feel pain, let the tears fall and my heart break
I won’t pretend I can hold it all
But let me weep where Your tears fall
The road to life is right in view
Still so many choose the grave
They trade Your mercy for the dust
And walk away from all You gave
You wait with open hands and grace
You warn with love and pain
You don’t delight in what is lost
You keep on calling out their name
Where Your tears fall, let me stand
Where Your heart is breaking, let me understand
While I can still feel pain, let the tears fall and my heart break
I won’t pretend I can hold it all
But let me weep where Your tears fall
Wake me up, don’t let me sleep
Don’t let me grow numb and cold
Give me a heart that feels the weight
Of every soul You’re trying to hold
One day You’ll make all things new
Wipe every tear away
Till the night gives way to dawn
Let me mourn and pray
